name: node-module-implement
title: Node.js Module Implementation
description: Implements a Node.js module from a structured ticket spec using a goldenflux hybrid approach: repo analysis → code generation → test verification → quality review.
author: SolFoundy

inputs.name: ticket_spec
inputs.description: Full ticket content (title + description + DONE-WHEN criteria)

inputs.name: module_name
inputs.description: Name of the module to implement (e.g., 'scoring')

gates.command: cd {{target_dir}} && (cat package.json 2>/dev/null || echo '{}') && echo '---' && (ls -la lib/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'no lib dir') && echo '---' && (find test -name '*.test.js' -o -name '*.spec.js' 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo 'no tests')

loop.on_success: Implementation complete: all DONE-WHEN criteria met, tests passing.
